script: In the NBA, there's an unwritten rule that you should always block your opponent's shot even if it doesn't count, as it's a way to get into a player's head by not letting them see the ball go through the hoop. But this player completely forgot there was still time left when the ball was shot, so he was called for a goaltend, counting the basket, and the Thunder lost the game by two points.
